question: What claim about classification requires all innate, all family-born, and all door-guarding yoginīs to be counted within the same set?
premises: Some are innate to all classes.
Some are born of all families.
Some are guardians of all doors, and all three groups are included.
inference: All innate yoginīs, all family-born yoginīs, and all door-guardians belong to the set in question.
plain_english: All innate, all family-born, and all door-guardians.
